n = int(input())
text = input()

max_len = 0
count_in_parentheses = 0
inside = False
last_letter_flag = False
current_len = 0

for c in text:
    if c == '(':
        inside = True
        last_letter_flag = False
        current_len = 0
    elif c == ')':
        inside = False
        last_letter_flag = False
        current_len = 0
    elif c.isalpha():
        if inside and not last_letter_flag:
            count_in_parentheses += 1
        elif not inside:
            current_len += 1
            if current_len > max_len:
                max_len = current_len
        last_letter_flag = True
    else:
        last_letter_flag = False
        current_len = 0

print(f"{max_len} {count_in_parentheses}")
